card.name: Quantity words before container units
card.fires_on: Small quantity words such as "a", "two", "more", "than" or "per" that come just before a container or serving unit like pint, pack, glass, pound, gallon or tsp. The setting is amounts of drink, tobacco, food or liquid.

modes.label: Article before a unit
modes.description: The word "a" or "two" after "less than" or "quarter of", right before a unit such as pint, pound or packet.
modes.example: Smoking<< a>> packet of 20 cigarettes can lead

modes.label: Quantity phrase in progress
modes.description: Words like "more", "than", "large" or "per" inside an amount phrase that will end in a container or measure.
modes.example: Patients who consume three or<< more>> alcoholic drinks every day

modes.label: Dose fraction before spoon
modes.description: A fraction or "half" in a dose table or instruction, expecting a unit like tsp or tablet.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward container words such as bottle and bottles.
card.plain: It lights up when a sentence is partway through an amount and the next word will be a container or serving unit, like a pint or a pack.
